description_en: Generates a backup file and uploads it to remote storage. You can use this operation for regular data backups. You can also back up files from one instance and restore them to multiple instances, a process similar to data replication or migration
description_zh: 生成备份文件并上传到远端存储。 使用场景：可以基于数据安全的角度进行定期备份，也可以备份一机文件，恢复到多机，实现类似复制迁移的效果
kebab_example: aliyun eds-aic backup-file --android-instance-id-list aic-ig2bdpk374l120000 --description This_is_a_backup/data_request. --source-file-path-list /data --source-app-list com.example.xhs --upload-type OSS --upload-endpoint oss-cn-shanghai-internal.aliyuncs.com --backup-file-path oss://cloudphone-saved-bucket-0000/backupDir/ --backup-file-name MyBackup --backup-all false --exclude-source-file-path-list example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: BackupFile

parameters.description_en:
The domain name of the upload URL.

> If you upload the file to an OSS bucket, call the DescribeBuckets operation to obtain the bucket information. If the cloud phone and the bucket are in the same region, use the value of the intranetEndpoint field. If they are in different regions, use the value of the extranetEndpoint field.
parameters.description_zh:
备份地址的域名。

> 如果上传到OSS Bucket，调用describeBuckets接口获取Bucket，如果云手机和Bucket是同地域，获取intranetEndpoint字段；如果是不同地域获取extranetEndpoint字段。
parameters.help_en:

parameters.name: upload_endpoint

parameters.description_en:
The upload URL for the backup file.

> If you upload the file to an OSS bucket, call the DescribeBuckets operation to get the bucketName. Then, select a key from ossObjectList. The key represents the folder path in the OSS bucket. Combine these values into the format `oss://${bucketName}/${key}`.
parameters.description_zh:
备份文件的上传地址。
> 如果上传到OSS Bucket，调用describeBuckets接口获取bucketName，选择ossObjectList获取key，key是OSS Bucket的文件夹路径，拼接成`oss://${bucketName}/${key}`。
